description.translate: Bring eight copper ingots for the signal fittings and roof conductor. We used to guide messengers here through bad weather. I would like the next one to arrive safely. Hand the materials to me one at a time.

He entrusted his ring to me for protective engraving and further study. He promised to help put this watchpost right when our work was done. The ring was still unfinished when he decided he was ready for the Inferno.
